{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows persistent underperformance (e.g., 3+ consecutive forecast errors > 5% below true value).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-15% to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true values when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.25) — adjust upward by 3-5% to capture momentum.",
    "Correct for lagged spikes: if true value spikes > 10% from prior period, reduce forecast by 10-20% to avoid overshoot.",
    "When sentiment is positive and forecast is below true value, apply a ‘catch-up’ rule: increase forecast by 5-8% to align with sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day spikes: if true value spikes > 15% from prior day, cap forecast increase to 5% to prevent volatility overcorrection."
  ]
}
